inputs: canonical groups and institutional asset ownership
participation, eligibility, access and obligation declarations with provenance
finite dated participation slots in one canonical account book
procedure: Validate canonical references, unique account/asset mappings, dimensions, scope and period. Deny declined participation, ineligibility, missing or denied access and offline capacity. Unknown prerequisites and conflicting obligations withhold all new allocations. Stage finite capacity through the shared allocator. Retain prior postings and reservations without inferring attendance or resolving rights.
independent_oracle: For both priority and all-or-nothing, enumerate 45 combinations of supply zero through four and two demands one through three; enumerate feasible integer pairs independently and select the lexicographic maximum under explicit first-group precedence.
limits: No resolved rights or conflicting obligations
No attendance, behavior, transition or source activation
No numerical IPC, parent or cumulative acceptance
review_route: SV separate author inspection; independent agent review deferred
